question: what is technology
what does technology mean
give me examples of technology
answer: Technology is the use of science and clever ideas to make tools and machines that solve problems and make life easier, like phones, computers, bicycles, water pumps and solar panels.

question: what is a computer
how does a computer work
what does a computer do
answer: A computer is an electronic machine that follows instructions to take in information (input), work with it (processing), save it (storage) and show results (output).

question: what are the parts of a computer
what is hardware
what is the difference between hardware and software
answer: Hardware is the parts of a computer you can touch, like the screen, keyboard, mouse and the system unit. Software is the programs and apps that tell the hardware what to do.

question: what is software
what is a program
what is an app
what is an application
answer: Software is a set of instructions, or programs, that tell a computer what to do. Apps like a calculator, a game or a web browser are software.

question: what is a cpu
what is the processor
what is the brain of the computer
what is the central processing unit
answer: The CPU, or central processing unit, is the brain of the computer. It carries out instructions and does the calculations, very fast.

question: what is ram
what is computer memory
what is the difference between ram and storage
answer: RAM is the computer's short-term memory, where it keeps what it's working on right now, and it clears when the power goes off. Storage, like a hard disk or SSD, keeps your files for a long time.

question: what is an input device
what is an output device
what are examples of input and output devices
answer: An input device sends information into the computer, like a keyboard, mouse, microphone and scanner. An output device shows results, like a monitor, printer and speaker.

question: what is binary
how do computers count
how do computers understand
what is a bit
what is a byte
answer: Computers use binary, which has only two digits, 0 and 1. One binary digit is a bit, and a group of 8 bits is a byte. Everything on a computer, like words, pictures and music, is stored as 0s and 1s.

question: what is the internet
how does the internet work
what is the web
what is the world wide web
answer: The internet is a giant network of computers all over the world connected together so they can share information. The World Wide Web, which you view with a browser, is just one of the things that run on it. Sir Tim Berners-Lee invented the web.

question: what is a web browser
what is a search engine
what is a website
what is a url
answer: A website is a collection of web pages. A browser, like Chrome or Firefox, lets you visit them using an address called a URL. A search engine helps you find pages by typing words.

question: what is wifi
what is wi-fi
what is a router
what is a network
answer: Wi-Fi lets devices connect to the internet without wires, using radio waves. A router sends the signal. A network is a group of computers and devices that are connected to share information.

question: what is the cloud
what is cloud storage
what is cloud computing
answer: The cloud means storing files and running programs on big computers called servers on the internet, instead of only on your own device. That way you can reach them from anywhere.

question: what is coding
what is programming
what is a programmer
what is computer programming
answer: Coding, or programming, is writing instructions that tell a computer exactly what to do, using a language it understands, like Python or Scratch. It's like writing a very careful recipe!

question: what is an algorithm
give me an example of an algorithm
answer: An algorithm is a step-by-step set of instructions to solve a problem, like a recipe. Brushing your teeth can be an algorithm: wet the brush, add toothpaste, brush all teeth, rinse.

question: what is a loop in programming
what is a variable in programming
what is a function in programming
what is a condition in coding
answer: In coding, a variable stores information, a loop repeats actions, a condition (if/else) makes a choice, and a function is a group of instructions you can reuse.

question: what is a bug in coding
what is debugging
why is it called a bug
how do i fix a bug
answer: A bug is a mistake in a program. Debugging means finding and fixing it. The word became famous in 1947 when engineers found a real moth stuck inside a computer and taped it in their logbook!

question: what is python
what is the python programming language
why is it called python
answer: Python is a popular, friendly programming language used for websites, science, data and robots. It was named after the British comedy show Monty Python, not the snake!

question: what is scratch
what is scratch programming
what is block coding
answer: Scratch is a free coding language where you snap colourful blocks together to make games, stories and animations. It was made at MIT for kids, and it's a great way to start coding!

question: what is html
what is css
what is javascript
how are websites made
answer: Websites are built with three languages: HTML gives the page its structure, CSS makes it look pretty, and JavaScript makes it interactive. Marshie's face was built that way too!

question: what is a raspberry pi
what is raspberry pi
tell me about raspberry pi
answer: A Raspberry Pi is a credit-card sized computer that costs very little but can run programs, connect to the internet and control electronics. It's made in the UK to help people learn to code. Helpers like me can even live inside one!

question: what is an arduino
what is a microbit
what is a microcontroller
what is a micro bit
answer: An Arduino or a BBC micro:bit is a tiny programmable circuit board, called a microcontroller, that can read sensors and control lights, motors and buzzers. It's great for making your own robots and inventions!

question: what is a sensor
what do sensors do
give me examples of sensors
answer: A sensor measures something in the world, like light, heat, sound, movement or distance, and sends the information to a computer. Phone cameras, thermometers and automatic doors use sensors.

question: what is a robot
how do robots work
what can robots do
what are the parts of a robot
answer: A robot is a machine that can be programmed to do tasks. Most robots have sensors to sense the world, a controller or computer to think, and motors to move. Robots help in factories, hospitals and even on Mars!

question: what is artificial intelligence
what is ai
how does ai work
are you ai
are you artificial intelligence
answer: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is when computers do things that normally need human thinking, like understanding speech, recognising pictures and answering questions. AI learns patterns from lots of examples. I'm a small AI helper, and I learn from my teachers and students!

question: what is machine learning
how do machines learn
how do you learn
answer: Machine learning is when a computer learns from lots of examples instead of being told every rule. Show it thousands of cat photos and it learns what a cat looks like. I learn from the questions and answers you teach me, too!

question: what is a chatbot
how does a chatbot work
how do you work
how do you answer questions
answer: A chatbot is a computer program you can talk to. I listen to your question, search all the knowledge my teachers and students have given me, pick the best answer, and say it. When I'm wrong, you can teach me!

question: what is data
what is a dataset
why is data important
what is data collection
answer: Data is information we collect, like numbers, measurements, words or survey answers. Scientists collect data, put it in tables and charts, and use it to find patterns and answer questions. Your Excel sheets are full of data!

question: what is a spreadsheet
what is microsoft excel
what is excel
what are rows and columns
answer: A spreadsheet, like Microsoft Excel, is a grid of cells made of rows (going across) and columns (going down) where you can store data and do calculations with formulas.

question: what is a database
what is a server
answer: A database is an organised collection of information that a computer can search quickly, like my memory! A server is a powerful computer that stores things and shares them with other computers.

question: how do i make a strong password
what is a strong password
how do i keep my password safe
what is a good password
answer: A strong password is long, at least 12 characters, and mixes words, numbers and symbols. Don't use your name or birthday, don't use the same password everywhere, and never share it, except with a parent or guardian.

question: what is phishing
what is a scam
what is a fake message
how do i spot a scam
answer: Phishing is when a fake message, email or website tricks you into giving away private details like passwords. If a message sounds too good to be true, is rushing you, or asks for secrets, don't click and tell a trusted adult.

question: what is cybersecurity
what is cyber security
why is cybersecurity important
how do i stay safe online
answer: Cybersecurity means protecting computers, phones and information from bad actors. Stay safe by using strong passwords, keeping apps updated, thinking before you click, and never sharing private details like your address, school timetable or photos with strangers.

question: what is a hacker
what is hacking
what is an ethical hacker
answer: A hacker is someone who gets into computer systems. Bad hackers break the rules to steal or cause harm. Ethical hackers, or 'white hats', are experts hired to find weak spots and fix them before criminals do.

question: what is a virus
what is malware
what is a computer virus
what is antivirus
answer: A computer virus is a harmful program that can damage files or spread to other computers. Malware is the name for all harmful software. Antivirus programs and updates help protect you, so only download apps from trusted places.

question: what is cyberbullying
what should i do if someone is mean online
what is online bullying
answer: Cyberbullying is being mean, scary or hurtful to someone online. If it happens, don't reply, save the evidence, block the person, and tell a trusted adult like a teacher or parent. It's never your fault, and you should never bully anyone either.

question: what should i not share online
what is personal information
is it safe to share my address online
answer: Never share personal information online, like your home address, phone number, passwords, school timetable or photos, with people you don't know in real life. If in doubt, ask a trusted adult first.

question: what is an engineer
what do engineers do
what is engineering
how do i become an engineer
answer: Engineers use science, maths and creativity to design and build things that solve problems, like roads, bridges, phones, power stations and robots. There are civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical and software engineers, and you can become one by loving maths and science and building things!

question: what is the engineering design process
what are the steps of the design process
how do engineers design things
answer: Engineers follow the design process: ask (what is the problem?), imagine (ideas), plan (choose the best idea), create (build a model), test (does it work?) and improve (make it better). It's okay to fail and try again!

question: what is a prototype
what is a model in engineering
answer: A prototype is the first test version of an invention. Engineers build prototypes to test their ideas and find problems before making the final product.

question: what is an invention
what is an inventor
who is an inventor
answer: An invention is something new that someone makes to solve a problem or help people. An inventor is a person who thinks of and builds it. You can be an inventor too!

question: what types of bridges are there
how do bridges work
what is a suspension bridge
what is an arch bridge
answer: Bridges let us cross rivers and valleys. Beam bridges are the simplest, arch bridges push their weight outwards, truss bridges use triangles for strength, and suspension bridges hang the road from cables. Ghana's Adomi Bridge over the Volta River is a suspension bridge.

question: why are triangles strong
what is the strongest shape
what is the strongest shape in engineering
answer: Triangles are very strong because they don't change shape when you push on them. That's why you see triangles in bridges, cranes and roof frames.

question: what is a solar panel
how do solar panels work
how do we get electricity from the sun
answer: A solar panel is a flat panel of special cells that turn sunlight into electricity. It's clean energy, and Ghana has plenty of sunshine to power homes, schools and farms!

question: what is a wind turbine
how do wind turbines work
answer: A wind turbine has big blades that the wind turns, and they spin a generator that makes electricity. It's clean, renewable energy.

question: what is hydroelectric power
what is hydropower
how does a dam make electricity
answer: Hydroelectric power uses flowing water to make electricity. Water rushes through a dam and spins turbines that run generators. Ghana's Akosombo Dam on the Volta River is a famous example.

question: what is a generator
what is a battery
how does a battery work
answer: A battery stores chemical energy and changes it into electrical energy when you connect it in a circuit. A generator makes electricity by spinning a magnet near coils of wire.

question: what is a drone
how do drones work
what do drones do
what are drones used for
answer: A drone is an aircraft without a pilot on board, flown by remote control or by a computer. Drones take photos, help farmers check crops, and in Ghana they deliver medicines and vaccines to faraway clinics!

question: what is a 3d printer
how does a 3d printer work
what is 3d printing
answer: A 3D printer builds a solid object layer by layer from a digital design, often using melted plastic. It can make toys, tools and even prosthetic hands!

question: what is a satellite
what is gps
what do satellites do
how does gps work
answer: A satellite is an object that orbits a planet. Satellites give us TV, phone signals, weather pictures and GPS, which tells us where we are. Ghana's first satellite, GhanaSat-1, was built by students at All Nations University and launched in 2017!

question: what is mobile money
what is a smartphone
how does a mobile phone work
answer: A smartphone is a pocket computer that can call, text, take photos and run apps. Mobile money lets people send, receive and save money using their phones, which is very popular in Ghana.

question: who invented the computer
who is the father of the computer
who is charles babbage
answer: Charles Babbage, an English mathematician, designed the first mechanical computer, called the Analytical Engine, in the 1830s, so he's called the father of the computer.

question: who was the first computer programmer
who is ada lovelace
who was ada lovelace
answer: Ada Lovelace was an English mathematician who wrote the first computer program in the 1840s, for Babbage's Analytical Engine. So she's often called the first computer programmer!

question: who is alan turing
who was alan turing
who is grace hopper
answer: Alan Turing was a British mathematician who helped crack secret codes in World War Two and laid the foundations of computer science and AI. Grace Hopper was an American computer scientist who created one of the first programming languages that used English-like words.

question: who invented the telephone
who invented the light bulb
who invented the aeroplane
who invented the telephone and light bulb
answer: Alexander Graham Bell is credited with inventing the telephone, in 1876. Thomas Edison made a long-lasting light bulb in 1879, and the Wright brothers, Orville and Wilbur, flew the first aeroplane in 1903.
